reconstruction.scope: Individual Brno Petrov cathedral: broad higher western nave and lower polygonal east choir, twin square stone towers beside their junction, open Gothic belfry/crowns and very slender green-gray metal needle spires. Smaller choir ridge fleche, metal roofs with small nave dormers, warm mixed rubble stone/pale trim, tall pointed glazing, stepped buttresses, west gabled facade and open outer portal with closed wood entry behind it. Low northern chapels and southern vestry follow approximate clips within mapped envelope. Shared materials, standard-terrain foundations. Exact sculpture/inscriptions, tiny latticework, stained-glass art, bells/interiors, surrounding town/landscaping and certified walking excluded.
